plain_description.what: Audit of whether the multi-benchmark union tree, and the main tree, ran LLM labelling or rubric generation on text that included copies of judged questions. Zero calls.
plain_description.why: If judged questions or their near-duplicates entered labelling or rubric prompts, rubric-based results could be contaminated.
plain_description.information: No labelling means the union tree is clean on that route; labelling with leaked copies means the affected results need disclosure. Result: the union tree and its six grafts ran no labelling or rubric generation. The main tree did: 28 judged questions had near-duplicate copies (with keys) in its rubric material, so that route applies to the rubric family of results. A separate text-matching hazard never reached any scorer.
